SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT KEY_1 AS LEGACY_PO_NO, COUNT(KEY_2) AS LEGACY_PO_COUNT FROM KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO' AND IF_FLAG = 'N' GROUP BY KEY_1
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT PLANT , STATUS , LEGACY_PO_NO , LEGACY_PO_SEQ , BUYER_ITEM_NO , CURRENCY_CODE , UNIT_PRICE , ITEM_QTY , ITEM_AMT , ADD_DATE , RD_DATE , DELY_TO_LOCATION , PURCHASER_USER_ID , LEGACY_PR_NO , LEGACY_PR_SEQ , REQ_USER_NAME , REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME , REQ_USER_TEL , REMARK , DESCRIPTION , SPECIFICATION , '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_COUNT$' AS LEGACY_PO_COUNT FROM V_KEP_PO, KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO' AND KEY_1 = LEGACY_PO_NO AND KEY_2 = LEGACY_PO_SEQ AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY LEGACY_PO_NO, TO_NUMBER(LEGACY_PO_SEQ)
UPDATE KEPTRXL SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', KEY_6 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
UPDATE KEPTRXL SET IF_FLAG = 'E', KEY_6 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
